description: Repairs r-def-cat-txn/link-select-in-clause-forms: the INSERT...SELECT had no destination column list (ID + 100 gave 3352), so its after read was dependent, and 3251 on every form left unclear whether the source-type string was missing. Without any linked table, in an empty ACCDB made by the probe, against the input r-def-cat-txn-lksrc-accdb by relative path: SELECT FROM T IN 'path'; SELECT FROM [;DATABASE=path].T; SELECT FROM [MS Access;DATABASE=path].T; SELECT FROM T IN '' [MS Access;DATABASE=path]; SELECT FROM T IN '' [;DATABASE=path]; and SELECT FROM T IN a path of a file that does not exist. Then INSERT INTO T (ID, V, S) IN 'path' SELECT ID + 100, V, S FROM T IN 'path' with the destination column list (DBEngine.Errors right before and after), the source rows through the IN form, and SELECT * INTO Local FROM T IN 'path' (DBEngine.Errors). Rows and errors after each.
